summary: The market is holding about 1% gains into early afternoon, with midcaps up over 1% and smallcaps flat. The rebound is broadening a little but still leans on large caps.

detail.tone: The latest print is noon (Nifty 22,451.90, +0.99%). By 12:29 the Nifty MidCap was up 1.09% and the SmallCap was flat (-0.01%), better than the narrow 11:30 picture.
